scope: Rendered design QA for the current synthetic, read-only vertical slice only.
summary: The current live fixture resolves the prior rendered design findings. The transcript distinguishes user, assistant, and assistant event; the ToolCall shows its name, target, and shared 24px 확인 완료 badge without a summary border; the result preview has its own boundary and declares ko-KR. No horizontal overflow or content clipping was observed at the three requested widths.

evidence.state: Workbench · Synthetic preview; fixed local fixture; read-only
observations: Screenshots at all three widths showed the intended hierarchy and legible wrapping; the 320px full-page capture included the preview and event.
At 320px, window.innerWidth and document scrollWidth were both 320px; at 390px both were 390px. The preview remained inside the viewport.
Rendered message metadata showed 사용자, 도우미, and 도우미 이벤트 with event provenance in the DOM.
The ToolCall summary computed border was zero; the shared status badge measured 24px tall. The preview’s own visible border computed to 1px.
The preview article declared lang=ko-KR and data-interactive=false. It had no link role or tab stop; the fixture contained no focusable controls.
No browser error logs were returned for the inspected tab.

prior_finding_verification.finding: Speaker and event provenance, ToolCall context, narrow heading, and inert fixture preview
Borderless ToolCall with shared 24px completion badge and Korean preview language

limits: This pass covers one static synthetic fixture. It does not verify live streaming, permission cards, error/recovery states, dark mode, 200% zoom, screen-reader pronunciation, real SDK effects, or overall product and release readiness. The running server’s bundle hash was not independently attested to the review-input source hash.
